function: Learns the continuous downlink beamforming function (BS precoder) of a CAPA MIMO link to maximize spectral efficiency, directly (BeaINR) or via a weighting-coefficient function (CoefINR) (pp. 1-4).
system: Downlink MIMO, continuous aperture arrays at BS (2x2 m) and user (0.5x0.5 m), line-of-sight, 2.4 GHz, N=min{MB,MU} streams, no RIS (pp. 2, 4-5).
method: Implicit neural representation: fully connected networks (BeaINR, CoefINR) mapping coordinates and user position to weights, trained unsupervised with negative-SE loss and Gauss-Legendre/Sobol integrals (pp. 3-4).
data_channel: Custom simulated line-of-sight continuous channel response of Eq. (3); user position uniform in x,y in (-5,5) m, z in (20,30) m; 500,000 training, 10,000 test samples (pp. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Trained at A_B=4 m^2, A_U=0.5 m^2, 2.4 GHz, user region z in (20,30) m; tested over A_B 2-6, A_U 0.3-0.7 m^2, 1.8-3 GHz, larger region (p. 5).
baselines: WMMSE (CoV-based iterative), Fourier-series method [3], SPDA discretization with SVD and water-filling [4]; all non-learned; no learned baseline (pp. 4-5).
metrics: Spectral efficiency (SE) versus total and peak current budgets and user CAPA size, SE ratio to WMMSE for generalization, inference time, training sample/time/space, quantization effects (pp. 4-5).
complexity: Measured inference time 0.062 s (BeaINR), 0.043 s (CoefINR) versus 0.378 s WMMSE; training 36.2 h and 3.68 h, space 4.72 M and 2.63 M (Table III, p. 5).
q1_support: p. 2: "CAPAs under line-of-sight conditions where both the BS and user"; the channel is the analytic LoS response of Eq. (3) with perfect CSI; no 3GPP, COST, DeepMIMO, or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 5: "Both networks are trained at a fixed carrier frequency" and tested over 1.8-3 GHz (Table II); also trained with A_B = 4 m^2 and tested over 2-6 m^2, and on a larger user region.
q3_support: p. 4: "against the following numerical baselines:"; p. 5: "Fourier: As proposed in [3]" plus WMMSE and SPDA, all non-learned; no earlier learned method or standard network is compared (BeaINR and CoefINR are both proposed).
q4_support: p. 5: "Table III compares the inference time and training complexity of" the methods; measured 0.062 s and 0.043 s inference, 36.2 h and 3.68 h training.
q5_support: p. 4: "For training, we generate 500,000 samples in"; channels are self-generated, with no code or data link or DOI and no public dataset.
notes: Included as area 3: a BS precoder is learned for CAPA MIMO. CAPA at both ends gives N=min{MB,MU} streams (p. 4), so the link is not single-antenna. q3 is 0 because BeaINR and CoefINR are both proposed and the three baselines are non-learned. Setup gives 0.5 m per side for the user CAPA (A_U=0.25 m^2, p. 4) while the generalization text trains with A_U=0.5 m^2 (p. 5); reported as stated. Table III was read from the page image. Title on p. 1 matches the DOI.
